meta.name: Line-art prompt library for KDP coloring books
meta.note: Single source of truth for generation prompts. Print specs live in the kdp-compliance skill's kdp_specs.json; this file holds only prompt content. Prompt terms are English for image models. Listing keywords are split PL/EN.
meta.trends_2026: Bold and easy is the top kids growth trend: thick outlines, one large subject per page, no clutter. Kawaii dominates the axolotl niche. Cozy and seasonal angles sell. 8.5x8.5 favored by many bestsellers. Detail scales up with age.
sources: amazon.com listings for axolotl and bold-and-easy toddler coloring books

core: black and white coloring book page

3-4.label: Toddlers / przedszkole młodsze
positive: very large open areas to color

5-6.label: Przedszkole starsze / zerówka
positive: a few simple background elements like bubbles or water plants

6-7.label: Wczesnoszkolne
positive: bold clean outlines with some finer accents
a small scene or habitat around the subject
more areas to color but still uncluttered

kawaii.label: Kawaii / cute
kawaii.note: Core seller in the axolotl niche. Works for every age group.

cozy.label: Cozy / lifestyle
cozy.note: Rides the strong cozy trend. Best for 5-6 and 6-7.

fantasy_costume.label: Fantasy / costume
fantasy_costume.note: Costumes and props add variety across a book.

seasonal.label: Seasonal / holiday
seasonal.note: Seasonal books are a reliable secondary angle. Pass --season to pick.

habitat_scene.label: Habitat / underwater scene
habitat_scene.note: Richer scenes for older kids. Keep areas large for 5-6.

realistic_simple.label: Simple realistic / educational
realistic_simple.note: Pairs well with fun-facts books for 6-7.

patterned.label: Patterned / decorative
positive: simple decorative patterns on the body
patterned.note: Adds coloring interest for 6-7 without clutter.

axolotl.label: Axolotl / aksolotl
scenes: swimming among soft water plants and bubbles
resting on a smooth round rock
sitting inside a teacup
wearing a tiny crown like a little king
holding a single round balloon
floating up with a bunch of balloons
peeking out from behind a lotus flower
blowing a stream of bubbles
sleeping curled up cozy
with a small snail sitting on its head
surfing on a big leaf
swimming among lily pads
wearing a flower crown
with a little bow on its head
swimming through a ring of bubbles
next to a small treasure chest
waving hello with a big smile
hugging a tiny fish friend
sitting in a small bowl with water
reading a little book

consistency.note: For one book, keep theme, age group and style fixed and vary only the scene. Reuse the same image-model seed or style reference across pages so the character of the line stays constant (workflow step 2). Generate a few pages first, confirm one consistent look, then generate the rest.
